record.explanation: The target 何曽 appears in Liu Xiaobiao's annotation to Shishuo Xinyu 24-jianao-001. The annotation text reads: '盡禮唯王祥長揖不拜/王司徒何曽與朝臣皆' — i.e., '王司徒何曽' where 王司徒 (Minister over the Masses Wang) is an office title applied to 何曽 (He Zeng). The validated local mention sfh1-mention-5deb7a645b33456f741563e7 identifies 王司徒 as an office_title reference, and the juxtaposition '王司徒何曽' makes clear that 王司徒 and 何曽 refer to the same person: He Zeng (何曾), a Jin-dynasty official who held the office of Situ (司徒, Minister over the Masses). The annotation contrasts his behavior with that of Wang Xiang (王祥), who alone performed a long bow without prostration before the Jin Wen Wang (Sima Zhao). He Zeng is thus a historical person, referenced by full name, appearing as a scene participant in the annotation's account of court ceremonial conduct.
